title: Detailed flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pot shadow / base rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='28' ry='6' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <!-- Pot body -->
  <path d='M28 55 L32 85 Q32 90 50 90 Q68 90 68 85 L72 55 Z' fill='#C96A32'/>
  <!-- Pot body highlight -->
  <path d='M32 55 L36 84 Q36 87 50 87 Q52 87 53 86 L48 55 Z' fill='#E08B4F' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Pot rim -->
  <rect x='25' y='50' width='50' height='9' rx='4' fill='#B85C28'/>
  <!-- Rim highlight -->
  <rect x='27' y='51' width='46' height='3' rx='2' fill='#E09A5F' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Rim top edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='25' ry='5' fill='#D4793C'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='20' ry='3.5' fill='#5A3A1E'/>
  <!-- Soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='18' ry='3' fill='#4A2E15'/>
  <!-- Soil dots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='1.2' fill='#6B4A2A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='53' r='1' fill='#6B4A2A'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='51' r='0.9' fill='#7A5A3A'/>
  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d='M50 52 Q50 35 48 25' stroke='#2E8B2E' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Stem branch left -->
  <path d='M49 38 Q40 34 35 28' stroke='#2E8B2E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Stem branch right -->
  <path d='M50 42 Q58 38 63 32' stroke='#2E8B2E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Leaf left -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='27' rx='8' ry='4.5' fill='#3CB43C' transform='rotate(-30 32 27)'/>
  <path d='M26 27 Q31 25 36 29' stroke='#2E8B2E' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Leaf right -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='30' rx='8' ry='4.5' fill='#3CB43C' transform='rotate(25 66 30)'/>
  <path d='M60 31 Q65 28 70 32' stroke='#2E8B2E' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Leaf mid-left -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='44' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#4CC44C' transform='rotate(-20 42 44)'/>
  <!-- Leaf mid-right -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='47' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#4CC44C' transform='rotate(15 58 47)'/>
  <!-- Flower 1 (top) petals -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='20' r='5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='23' r='5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='23' r='5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='28' r='5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='28' r='5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <!-- Flower 1 center -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='24' r='3' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Flower 2 (left) petals -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='25' r='4.5' fill='#FF85B3'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='#FF85B3'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='#FF85B3'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='32' r='4.5' fill='#FF85B3'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='32' r='4.5' fill='#FF85B3'/>
  <!-- Flower 2 center -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='29' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Flower 3 (right) petals -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='31' r='4.5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='31' r='4.5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='35' r='4.5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='35' r='4.5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <!-- Flower 3 center -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Small bud -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='3' fill='#FFA0C0'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Pot decorative band -->
  <rect x='30' y='65' width='40' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A84E20'/>
  <rect x='30' y='65' width='40' height='1.5' rx='1' fill='#D4793C' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Pot decorative dots on band -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='67' r='0.8' fill='#E09A5F'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='67' r='0.8' fill='#E09A5F'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='67' r='0.8' fill='#E09A5F'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='67' r='0.8' fill='#E09A5F'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='67' r='0.8' fill='#E09A5F'/>
  <!-- Pot bottom rim -->
  <rect x='34' y='84' width='32' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A84E20'/>
</svg>
